summary: Ran the documented pinned-host v1.1 matrix in docs/testing/jellyfin-12-musl-test-host.md against the pinned Jellyfin 12.0.0 amd64-musl host (fresh prefix /tmp/arrtags-14.3) using the committed release candidate artifacts/ArrTags_1.1.0.0.zip (594,931 bytes; SHA-256 85730fe7b3fb8b03c86a87228dc1043d42844b372a9493d4caf5bba4a7e836e1; identity matches docs/release/build-and-release.md). All eight matrix rows pass and the result is recorded machine-readably in docs/implementation/14.3/live-verification.json. The package installs into the versioned folder data/plugins/ArrTags_1.1.0.0 and loads as 'Loaded plugin: ArrTags 1.1.0.0' with targetAbi 12.0.0.0 and status Active, with no plugin-folder SkiaSharp assembly and no [FTL]. Goal A: the embedded settings page resource is served anonymously (GET /web/ConfigurationPage?name=ArrTags -> 200 text/html 37,180 bytes), the page list and the GET/POST /Plugins/{guid}/Configuration path are elevation-gated (anonymous -> 401; admin GET -> 200, POST -> 204), a valid save activates the providers at runtime with no restart and re-renders existing posters after a Renderer.Position/Size change (movie 4eaebb1e/85f12abb -> a6ac44e8/0a834c35; episode e30720eb/71050c94 -> 20142a17/445735fb). ADR-021 is now live-verified: an invalid candidate (Sonarr.BaseUrl=not-a-url) is not persisted (ArrTags.xml SHA-256 unchanged) and writes exactly one bounded, secret-free administrator-visible activity-log entry (Type ArrTagsConfigurationRejected, Severity Warning, Name 30 / Type 28 / Overview 154 / ShortOverview 110 chars, 0 candidate/secret leak matches), while a valid save writes none. Goal C: a reconciliation window with 3 work items made exactly one /api/v3/movie and one /api/v3/series library read, and post-save and library-refresh invalidation each produced fresh reads. Goal F: LogVerbosity Warning/Information/Off applied without restart (0/4/0 new ArrTags log lines) and every line was secret-free. Core invariants: the image route served bytes equal to the persisted ActiveImageIdentity, the original poster sidecars and .nfo files were byte-unchanged, a provider outage (503) left the host up 10/10 with artwork unchanged and metadata stale, and install/restart/uninstall was clean (one load on restart, state preserved; DELETE /Plugins/{guid}/1.1.0.0 removed the install folder and the relocated state root with 0 loads and 0 [ERR]/[FTL] on the clean restart). The repository working tree was clean before the report files were added; no release artifact, tracked file, or plugin was modified.
validation: Artifact identity: artifacts/ArrTags_1.1.0.0.zip is 594,931 bytes, SHA-256 85730fe7b3fb8b03c86a87228dc1043d42844b372a9493d4caf5bba4a7e836e1, MD5 547beb2f7d83cd256d3a3ce7bb7e7620, 7 entries - identical to docs/release/build-and-release.md. No mismatch was present, so the artifact was installed.

L1 install/load: extracted the zip into /tmp/arrtags-14.3/data/plugins/ArrTags_1.1.0.0 and restarted via scripts/provision-jellyfin-test-host.sh /tmp/arrtags-14.3. Console: 'Loaded assembly ArrTags, Version=1.1.0.0 ... from /tmp/arrtags-14.3/data/plugins/ArrTags_1.1.0.0/ArrTags.dll'; 'Loaded plugin: ArrTags 1.1.0.0'. Plugin meta.json: version 1.1.0.0, targetAbi 12.0.0.0, status Active. Plugin-folder SkiaSharp.dll/libSkiaSharp.so count 0; 'Loaded assembly SkiaSharp' count 0; [FTL] count 0; [ERR] count 2, both host-internal and pre-existing (cancelled-scan OperationCanceledException; CollectionFolderMetadataService/SkiaSharp.HarfBuzz typeface), no ArrTags [ERR].

L2 settings page + elevation: anon GET /web/ConfigurationPage?name=ArrTags -> 200 text/html 37,180 bytes; anon GET /web/ConfigurationPages -> 401; anon GET /Plugins/{guid}/Configuration -> 401; anon POST /Plugins/{guid}/Configuration -> 401; admin GET /Plugins -> ArrTags 1.1.0.0 Active; admin GET /web/ConfigurationPages -> ArrTags entry; admin GET config -> 200 (providers disabled, LogVerbosity Warning, Renderer default); admin POST valid -> 204.

L3 runtime activation without restart: POST of a valid candidate returned 204 and persisted Enabled=true plus the Sonarr/Radarr base URLs into data/plugins/configurations/ArrTags.xml; immediately, with no restart, the post-save Reconciliation (PostSave) read both providers (GET /api/v3/series, /api/v3/movie, /api/v3/moviefile?movieId=1, /api/v3/episode?seriesId=1&includeEpisodeFile=true, /api/v3/episode?seriesId=2&includeEpisodeFile=true, /api/v3/episodeFile?episodeFileIds=201). Host startup count stayed 1.

L4 post-save re-render: first publication tags/bytes movie 4eaebb1e/85f12abb (5,971 bytes) and episode e30720eb/71050c94 (8,220 bytes), both equal to ActiveImageIdentity; after POST 204 of Renderer.Position=TopRight and Renderer.Size=Large (no restart) movie -> a6ac44e8 / 0a834c35 (7,952 bytes) and episode -> 20142a17 / 445735fb (6,626 bytes). The post-save reconciliation performed fresh provider reads.

L5 ADR-021: POST invalid (Sonarr.BaseUrl=not-a-url) -> 204; /System/ActivityLog/Entries TotalRecordCount 3 -> 4 (exactly +1); entry {Name 'ArrTags configuration rejected' 30 chars, Type 'ArrTagsConfigurationRejected' 28 chars, Overview 154 chars, ShortOverview 110 chars, UserId 00000000000000000000000000000000, Severity Warning}; candidate/secret leak matches 0; persisted ArrTags.xml SHA-256 unchanged (6e72445c7f25d896d6664f8b1a019ef34d5f7983ebc0ccfaf55dbb25fba7b9d0) so the rejected candidate was not persisted and the last valid config stayed active; a following valid save returned 204 and left the count at 4 (no entry).

L6 inventory cache: manual reconciliation window with 3 eligible work items (2 movies + 1 episode) produced exactly 1 GET /api/v3/movie and 1 GET /api/v3/series; the post-save and library-refresh windows each produced fresh library reads (invalidation).

L7 logging: POST LogVerbosity=Warning -> 0 new ArrTags log lines; Information -> 4 new lines (e.g. 'Reconciliation (Scheduled) Completed: inspected 3, eligible 3, enqueued 3'); Off -> 0 new lines; no host restart (console.log startup count 1) and GET /System/Info/Public stayed 200. Secret scan over console.log and log/: 0 occurrences of the mock API keys or the local test password.

L8 invariants: fresh publish readback movie e7e1a22c (5,988 bytes) and episode 5c926d77 (8,210 bytes) each equalled the persisted ActiveImageIdentity; source media/movies/ArrTagsTestMovie2020/poster.jpg (93237bc3...), media/tv/ArrTagsTestShow/Season 01/ArrTagsTestShow.S01E01.jpg (cf4c625e...) and all three .nfo files were byte-unchanged and matched the persisted SourceArtifactId; provider outage (radarr/failure + sonarr/failure -> both 503) left the host at 10/10 HTTP 200 with served bytes/tags unchanged, all three metadata-state records State=1 (stale), no [FTL], only bounded WRN provider-unavailable lines; restart with the plugin installed loaded exactly 1 plugin and preserved both artwork-state records with the image route still matching ActiveImageIdentity and 0 [ERR]/[FTL]; DELETE /Plugins/{guid}/1.1.0.0 -> 204 removed the install folder and the relocated state root and a clean restart logged 0 'Loaded plugin: ArrTags', 1 'Startup complete', 0 [FTL], 0 ArrTags [ERR].

Documented fail-closed observation: a POST /Library/Refresh full scan that re-adopted the local sidecar as the Primary image was detected as OwnershipLost (artwork-state State=2, LastOwnershipObservation.Status=1 'The active image content hash changed.'); ArrTags then correctly does not auto-republish (docs/data-model.md 3.10.4; docs/architecture.md), so the readback served the host image until an explicit administrative action would start a new session. This is intentional, not a defect.

Repository hygiene: `git status --short` was empty before the task report files were created; scripts/mock-arr-fixtures/ is unmodified (the outage test used a copy under /tmp/final-review/live-host/fixtures); artifacts/ArrTags_1.1.0.0.zip and all tracked product files are unchanged. The mock and the host were stopped/left cleanly.
known_limitations: The live host is the pinned Jellyfin 12.0.0 amd64-musl fixture and the provider side is the committed mock Arr fixture (scripts/mock-arr-fixture.cs + scripts/mock-arr-fixtures/); no real Sonarr/Radarr instance was available, so real-release payload-shape variance beyond the fixtures remains covered only by the ADR-013 contract fixtures.

The badge value allowlist (Goal B) was not separately exercised live; the output-affecting renderer-option requirement was satisfied live by the configurable badge position and size (Renderer.Position/Size changed the served bytes and item tags without a restart).
The startup wizard and a throwaway local admin user were created on the disposable prefix to authenticate the elevation-gated calls; this is test-host state only and is documented, not reverted.

An initial setup iteration enabled SaveLocalMetadata=true on the libraries, which caused Jellyfin's own local image saver (not ArrTags) to rewrite the media sidecars (badge written as folder.png/-thumb.png and the original poster.jpg/S01E01.jpg removed). The run was reset to a fresh prefix with SaveLocalMetadata=false; recorded as finding F-14.3-1 and now warned about in docs/testing/jellyfin-12-musl-test-host.md.

Two [ERR] lines appeared on the host during the run and are pre-existing host-internal conditions unrelated to ArrTags (0 [FTL]): a cancelled-library-scan OperationCanceledException and the known CollectionFolderMetadataService/SkiaSharp.HarfBuzz 'typeface' null when generating the collection-folder collage on this font-less musl host. Both were also recorded by tasks 7.3/7.8.
Jellyfin Enhanced is not installed on the pinned host, so live coexistence (GOALS criterion 7) remains contract-tested only, as in tasks 7.3/7.8.

Uninstall retained data/plugins/configurations/ArrTags.xml, which is host-managed (PluginConfigurationManager) and retained across reinstall; the plugin-owned state root and install folder were removed by the bounded drain.
